newsitem.title: USA: Just For Feet says shareholder files suit.
newsitem.headline: Just For Feet says shareholder files suit.

text.p: Just For Feet Inc said one of its shareholders filed a lawsuit against the company, alleging improprieties in its June public offering.
The suit alleged the company's registration statement and prospectus contained materially misleading financial statements, Just For Feet said.
The company said the shareholder purports to represent a class consisting of all people who purchased Just For Feet common stock in the public offering.

The company said the shareholder is suing the company, certain of its officers and directors, certain shareholders who sold shares in the public offering and two of the offering's four managing underwriters.

The company said the lawsuit was filed in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Alabama on June 27. The suit alleges violations of sections 11, 12 and 15 of the Securities Act of 1933 and Section 8-6-19 of the Alabama Securities Act and seeks an unspecified amount of damages, Just For Feet said.
The company said it believes the claims are without merit and intends to vigorously defend this suit.
